decision: the PostToolUse of a SendUserFile call carries tool_input as Claude wrote it and tool_response = {caption, display, attachments: [{path, size, isImage, media_type, pathValidated, file_uuid}]}, one attachment per input path in input order, each path absolute and resolved against the working directory of Claude Code; the body also carries cwd and transcript_path
why: the card, the copy and the file a click opens all need the resolved path and the size of each file a call sent
evidence: a call with the relative paths icon.png and sub/report.md in a tmux session of Claude Code 2.1.322 on Haiku 5.5 with Remote Control on, its hook bodies captured with cat; hub/test/fixtures/hooks/PostToolUse-SendUserFile.json is that body with neutral paths

decision: the PreToolUse of the same call carries the same tool_input, relative paths still relative, and fired 575 ms before the PostToolUse
why: decides that the hub copies at PostToolUse, which names resolved paths and comes after any approval, and not at PreToolUse
evidence: the same spike, hook bodies pre-1794415548016631510.json and post-1794415548591820017.json

decision: in a transcript the tool result of a SendUserFile call is the text N file(s) delivered to user. followed by one line per delivered file, two spaces, its resolved path, then → file_uuid: and the upload UUID; getSessionMessages() leaves out toolUseResult, which holds the attachments
why: a card the hub rebuilds from history after a restart has only input.files and this text to find the files
evidence: all 304 SendUserFile tool results in the local transcripts on 2026-11-11 are such strings; the SDK reader in claude-agent-sdk 0.3.310 keeps no toolUseResult

decision: no subagent has called SendUserFile: the 319 calls in 1636 local transcripts sit in 36 main transcripts, none in a subagents folder and none marked isSidechain
why: a send of a subagent gets no card and no copy, since the chat and the SDK history leave out subagent tools

decision: 88 of the 215 distinct paths that toolUseResult attachments name are gone from the VPS, and only 20 of those were under /tmp/claude-0
why: the hub has to copy a file when Claude sends it, since browsing the session folder later would not find most of the lost ones

decision: Claude Code offers SendUserFile only while a Remote Control client is connected or in a cloud session, and the 2.1.322 binary gates it behind a first-party provider and server-side flags; all 31 sessions orfoni had started were offered it, and 8 used it
why: if Remote Control or a flag goes off, Claude stops getting the tool and no cards appear, which belongs in the risks
evidence: the Claude Code tools reference, the 2.1.322 binary, and the transcripts of the sessions orfoni started, read on 2026-11-11
